description.narrative:
The SWIS Hub Project is a youth-led, 12-month initiative tackling gender inequality in STEM (SDG 5). We will test a hybrid innovation model by launching a digital community platform and running four physical ‘Pop-Up Innovation Labs’ across Nigeria. The project will equip 150+ young women from low-income and rural backgrounds with hands-on skills in STEM subjects such as engineering, AI, data science, and science communication. It also includes a 20-woman Media Fellowship and peer-led STEM Circles to build a sustainable support network. This pilot aims to bridge the innovation access gap and create a replicable blueprint for empowering young African women in STEM.
Goal: Increase participation <(>&<)> leadership of young Nigerian women in STEM.
Objectives: 1. Launch <(>&<)> test ahybrid digital/physical SWIS Hub community. 2. Strengthen innovation capacity of 150+ women through labs <(>&<)> a Media Fellowship. 3. Create a sustainable peer-support model via STEM Circles.
Key Activities:Develop SWIS Hub digital platform; conduct 4 Pop-Up Innovation Labs (diverse STEM fields); run 20-woman Media Fellowship; establish 10 peer-led STEM Circles.

participating-org.narrative:
SWIS Africa (Shaping Women in STEM, Africa) is a registered, youth-led NGO with a proven track record of designing and implementingprograms that directly tackle the global challenge of gender inequality in STEM (SDG 5). Our innovative approach lies at the intersection of narrative change (through our SWIS ART media fellowships) and practical skill-building (via our EmpowHER and High School projects). We successfully leverage partnerships with universities and industry professionals to deliver impact. Our governance and operational team are 100% youth, ensuring our solutions are co-created by and for the generation we serve. We are uniquely positionedto pilot and scale innovative, hybrid (digital/physical) models that empower young women as the next generation of innovators and problem-solvers in Africa.
Vision: To become the leading organization inspiring young African women in STEM to pursue and achieve their purpose.
Mission: To celebrate, promote, and shape African women in STEM through storytelling, innovative programs, and strategic partnerships.
Objectives: Amplify the visibility and achievements of African women in STEM through digital storytelling and media. Build the capacity of young women through targeted training, mentorship, andhands-on programs in research, innovation, and careerreadiness. Foster an inclusive, supportive ecosystem by connecting women across academia, industry, and entrepreneurship. Advocate for greater gender equity and representation in STEM fields across Africa.
Values: Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, Empowerment, and Excellence.
